reasons.explanation: Zero introduced findings across the two required A-min clusters (coupling, overeng). The cycle is bounded UI persistence plumbing: one new single-purpose service (services/tour.ts, +51 LOC) mirroring the existing services/onboarding.ts shape, two mount sites (TutorialStepper.handleFinish awaits markTourCompleted, +11/-1; WelcomeOverlay reads readTourCompletedSync and renders the disabled-state button variant, +61/-2), one CSS rule (+9 LOC), and one Playwright spec (+114 LOC). No new module-level dependency edges: services/tour.ts imports only the existing opfs-bridge adapter; TutorialStepper.tsx imports only the new sibling service via the same pattern OnboardingBanner uses for services/onboarding. No circular dependency, no shared mutable state, no new global registries, no premature abstraction, no CMS-shaped data structure, no speculative generality, no gold-plating. The introduced asymmetry between services/tour.ts:isTourCompleted() (localStorage-only) and the WelcomeOverlay sync reader (OPFS-first) is acknowledged in verify-report.md §Suggestions as a future-cycle cleanup; it is a deliberate scope choice that does not change production behaviour because the production reader is the OPFS-aware WelcomeOverlay path.
